crossRefs.note: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
“Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.
Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his…
Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze; and you will…
The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of…
The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run…
The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

translations.web: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.
translations.bsb: Their arrows are sharpened, and all their bows are strung. The hooves of their horses are like flint; their chariot wheels are like a whirlwind.
translations.kjv: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
translations.asv: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent; their horses' hoofs shall be accounted as flint, and their wheels as a whirlwind:
